findings.title: Search route builds SQL with request input
findings.description: The fixture search handler concatenates a request query parameter into a SQL string.

evidence.assessment: The query string is built with req.query.email rather than a parameterized query or validated input.

findings.gap: Secure coding controls do not prevent injection in the search route.
findings.recommendation: Replace string concatenation with a parameterized query and validate the email input before querying.

recommendations: Use parameterized queries for all database access
Validate request query parameters with a schema validator
